text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go looking for Taiki Shuttle to see how she's doing before the race…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay. On the fourth corner, I'll kick it into high gear, and…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey there, Trainer! You gotta say somethin' when you come in!
choice_data_list: Sorry, it looked like you were focusing.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe, 'course I was! A real cowgirl knows ya gotta get in the zone before a showdown!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna show ya a true Texan quick draw out there on the turf!
